summary: Comprehensive testing of the shared Forge CRUD framework (backend + frontend). Backend: 21 pytest cases covering create/list/get/update/delete across all module/kind combos (story chapter|draft|beat, world location|faction|rule|timeline, video scene|shot|render, voice profile, music brief, image gallery|asset, workflow graph), edge cases (404s, empty PUT -> 400, kind filter), project-delete cascade of forge_items, and Character ai_prompt field. All 21 pass (100%). Frontend (Playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): created a project, exercised full Story-Forge Chapters flow (empty-title toast validation, create, immediate render, F5 persistence, edit reopen shows saved values, edit persists, delete removes), created a World-Forge location, verified provider-required banners appear on Image/Video/Voice/Music forges (as intended — providers not enabled by default), created a Workflow, created a Character via 'Create with AI' mode and confirmed the Consistency tab renders the stored original AI prompt. No React error overlay observed at any point. Cleaned up TEST_ projects via DELETE /api/projects/{id} (cascades forge_items).
critical_code_review_comments: forge_items.py update_item requires at least one field or 400s — acceptable, but consider treating an all-null PUT as a no-op returning the current doc for idempotency.
ForgeWorkspace edit/delete buttons only appear on group-hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100); this is not keyboard-accessible. Consider always visible or focus-visible variant for a11y.

ItemFormModal onSubmit swallows non-axios errors (only inspects err.response.data.detail). If mutation throws a plain Error, users get a generic 'Could not save' toast — acceptable but underlying error is lost from telemetry.
Only 3 providers seeded enabled; image/video/voice/music banners are working as intended per test spec — no action required.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_forge_pytest (via pytest, auto-cleaned), TEST_cascade (auto-deleted in test), TEST_forge_e2e and TEST_forge_e2e2 (via Playwright, cleaned up via API at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route paths in the app are /story, /world, /image, /video, /voice, /music, /workflow, /character (NOT /story-forge etc). Data-testids used: forge-new-{kind}, forge-item-modal, field-{name}, forge-item-submit, forge-item-{id}, forge-edit-{id}, forge-delete-{id}, {moduleId}-tab-{tabId} (e.g. story-forge-tab-chapters), provider-required-{image|video|voice|music}, character-new-btn, char-mode-quick, char-mode-ai, character-ai-prompt, character-name-input, character-submit-btn, char-tab-consistency, ai-prompt-block, workflow-name-input, workflow-create-btn. World timeline uses kind='timeline_event' (not 'timeline'). Backend Character POST is /api/projects/{pid}/characters (project_id in URL, not body).
